notes: No database was consulted; every finding is derived from numbers the chapter itself publishes. The single most consequential defect is the 589-vs-588 service-floor split (finding 1), because it is the chapter's most-repeated literal and it also falsifies the explicit 'reproduces the committed figures to the digit' claim (finding 2). The second most consequential is finding 3, a self-contradiction inside one sentence that weakens the EWMA argument as written. Findings 3 and 4 CONFIRM the extractor's flag #2 (the ~14% margin) with the correction that neither 12.5% nor 0.1% is 14%, and CONFIRM flag #1 (588/589) with the arithmetic 316.4+272=588.4. The extractor's list of passing checks was independently reverified and all of them hold. The mechanism/detector paragraph (lines 150-190) and the language-hook implementation detail (lines 289-299) contain no internally recomputable relations and were not gradeable in this pass.
